newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean mth-mth forex holdings rise in April.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean mth-mth forex holdings rise in April.

text.p: South Korea's foreign exchange reserves rose to $29.83 billion at the end of April from $29.15 billion in March, the central Bank of Korea (BOK) said on Wedensday.
A BOK statement attributed the rise to a declining trade deficit and subdued speculative demand for foreign currency.
South Korea's customs-cleared trade shortfall narrowed to $1.5 billion in April from a $2.04 billion a year earlier and $1.85 billion a month ago.
The statement said the won/dollar rate remained stable at around the 890 level in line with further liberalisation of the capital markets.
But foreign exchange reserves fell from $33.24 billion at the end of 1996.
BOK forecast foreign exchange holdings were rising aided by improving current account deficit and an inflow of foreign funds for stock investment in the Seoul bourse.
